_note: Categories run in this order, cheapest and least stateful first. needs: freshdb = reset the test database first; api = the test API on port 3100; web = Vite on port 5175; browsers = Playwright browsers; build = needs the built web app (an earlier category builds it).

categories.title: black formatting check (Python tests)
categories.cmd: python -m black --check --config tests/pyproject.toml tests/conftest.py tests/python tests/regression

categories.title: pylint 10/10 (Python tests)
categories.cmd: python -m pylint --rcfile tests/.pylintrc tests/conftest.py tests/python tests/regression
